definitions.content: Certification body or inspection body from an OIML Member State approved by the Management Committee to issue OIML certificates and associated OIML type evaluation reports in accordance with Scheme A or Scheme B

notes.content: Note 1: An OIML Member State having an OIML Issuing Authority for a category of measuring instrument under Scheme A shall designate at least one Utilizer (see 3.45) for that category of measuring instrument. The Utilizer(s) may be a different organisation(s) than the OIML Issuing Authority.
Note 2: The requirement to designate at least one Utilizer (see 3.45) shall not apply when the OIML Member State does not regulate that particular category of measuring instrument in their country.
